correctness.rationale: The exact second-Cesàro weights w_(n,j)=(H_n-H_(j-1))/n strictly decrease; exchanging an out-of-order 1 proves unique all-first/all-last k-one extrema. Telescoping yields vmax=(k/n)(1+Hn-Hk), vmin=k/n-((n-k)/n)(Hn-H_(n-k)). Harmonic integral inequalities bound the logarithmic limits by 1/n, including k=0,n. Indicator blocks for intervals [a,a+u] realize every v in [L(u),U(u)] after arbitrary finite prefixes because the weights converge to -log t integrals and the arbitrary prefix vanishes as O(M log(N/M)/N). A countable intersection of open dense late-hit sets and compact cluster-set closure gives one residual Gdelta attaining every point. Differentiating the width gives unique maximum log 2 at u=1/2. Independently enumerated all 8190 binary words n<=12 by direct rational sums and verified endpoint inequalities; this finite diagnostic is not the Baire/infinite proof.
